pcomms.title: Platform settings
pcomms.lead: The platform's own e-mail and WhatsApp: account e-mails, messages to clinics, warehouses and reps from the CRM, and the WhatsApp link shown on the website.
pcomms.mail_sub: The address account e-mails, sign-up e-mails and CRM e-mails are sent from.
pcomms.mail_env_note: The server's environment sets SMTP (SMTP_HOST): it is used, and the settings below wait until it is removed.
pcomms.secret_saved: Saved — leave empty to keep it.
pcomms.wa_sub: Send WhatsApp messages from the platform's number (WhatsApp Business Cloud API) and publish a click-to-chat link.
pcomms.wa_token_help: A permanent token of a system user.
pcomms.wa_default_dial_help: For local numbers such as 079… (962 Jordan, 966 Saudi Arabia).
pcomms.wa_public_sub: The number visitors and clinics write to, with a ready message. Share the link anywhere (social media, e-mail signature, ads).
pcomms.wa_public_button: Show a WhatsApp button on the platform's website
pcomms.wa_link_help: Copy it and publish it: whoever opens it chats with you on WhatsApp with the ready message.
pcomms.geo_sub: The Activity page shows each account's country. When the server is behind Cloudflare the country comes with each visit; otherwise it can be looked up from the IP address.
pcomms.geo_lookup: Look up the country and city of IP addresses (ipwho.is) when I press "Locate" on the Activity page
pcomms.test_email_failed: The test e-mail was not sent.
pcomms.test_whatsapp_text: Test message from the platform: WhatsApp works.
pcomms.test_whatsapp_failed: The WhatsApp message was not sent.
pcomms.activity_lead: Accounts using the platform now and lately, with their clinic or warehouse, country, address and device.
pcomms.country_note: * the clinic's country (the visit's country is not known yet).
pcomms.geo_enable: Turn on locating by IP address
pcomms.geo_off: Locating by IP address is off (Platform settings).
